summary: Fortnite entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Fortnite
entries.definitive_edition: Current PC release via Epic Games Store

emulation.notes: Use the current native or official release route where available.

primary.version: Current Fortnite PC release via Epic Games Store
primary.why: The current Windows PC build offers the highest graphics/capture ceiling and access to Fortnite's main ecosystem. Save the World is available separately, and that PvE mode is excluded on mobile and original Switch.
primary.how_to_play: Install Fortnite through Epic Games Store on a high-end Windows PC, set visual quality based on the capture target, and record the game version/season because maps, modes, quests, and events rotate.

all_releases.fidelity: Highest scalable graphics and capture route for Battle Royale, Creative/UEFN experiences, and supported Epic modes.
all_releases.reason: primary: best fidelity and broadest practical access to current Fortnite content.

all_releases.fidelity: Strong console builds with shared progression and Save the World support, but less configurable than PC capture.
all_releases.reason: skip: good fallback, no sourced exclusive story/missions requiring secondary play.

all_releases.fidelity: Portable console route; original Switch lacks Save the World, which is offered separately from smartphone, tablet, and original Switch availability.
all_releases.reason: skip: lower capture/fidelity than PC and no exclusive archive content sourced.

all_releases.fidelity: Mobile route for supported devices; Save the World remains unavailable on smartphones and tablets.
all_releases.reason: skip: useful for mobile-only inspection, but PC is higher fidelity and more complete for the full Fortnite ecosystem.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Fortnite is a live platform rather than a static package: the PC route is best for fidelity/completeness, but rotating seasons/events mean no single capture preserves all historical content.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service content changes constantly; Save the World availability differs by platform, and smartphones/tablets/original Switch are not complete routes for that mode.
